entries.description: Notice that Lavender Hill in Elk, CA was sold to the Hare Krishna and is no longer women's land.
entries.raw_text: LAVENDER HILL (listed in VI,1) 1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, CA 95432 - was sold last month to the Hare Krishna. So, it is NO LONGER WOMIN'S LAND, it is not a place for womin to visit, and we have lost it. It is sad for those of us who lived there, but good for those womin (many of them crones) who had money invested and wanted it out. Time to move on.
entries.notes: Not a listing: notice that the community was sold ('was sold last month to the Hare Krishna. So, it is NO LONGER WOMIN'S LAND'). Street address '1085 Greenwood Rd, Elk, CA 95432' copied to land_* as the location of the former land. Note: the top half of the page contains non-directory sections (events, correspondence clubs, books/albums received) above the 'DIRECTORY OF LAND GROUPS' heading.

entries.description: Two lesbians currently living in Massachusetts who own land in Frankfort, Maine, with plans to build in 1983 or 1984 and eventually form a small lesbian community. They are especially interested in hearing from older lesbian women, artists, and lesbian women with girl children.
entries.raw_text: REGGIE ODOM & EILEEN KENNEDY 86 Rossmore Rd #3, Jamaica Plain, MA 02130 (617)522-2472. If we haven't replied within 15 days, write us c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438, where our land is located. We are two radical lesbians, ages 34 & 37, who are currently living in city with plans to build as soon as financially possible ('83 or '84). Eventually, want to form small lesbian community on land; especially interested in hearing from older lesbians, artists, dykes with girl children.
entries.notes: Type is Private/Individual Land under the two-woman rule ('We are two radical lesbians') and because the owners do not live on the land yet ('currently living in city with plans to build... Eventually, want to form small lesbian community on land'). num_residents is 0 because they are 'currently living in city'. Primary mailing address is in Jamaica Plain, MA; secondary address 'c/o General Delivery, Frankfort, ME 04438, where our land is located' gives land_city Frankfort, land_state ME, and land_zip 04438. Accepted groups: Lesbian women and Girl children from 'older lesbians, artists, dykes with girl children'. Focuses: Older women ('especially interested in hearing from older lesbians') and Archives/cultural work ('artists').
